provenance: Obstacle batch 10 (owner priority #1, 2026-10-03, rest batch): teleports whose destination is a counterpart loc / walkable tile of this 667 map (CACHE) plus the OSRS/RS3 Wiki for the area. Every landing checked walkable with MapProbe.

teleports.name: keep_le_faye_basement_down
teleports.source: King's Ransom keep basement (667 map, batch 10 2026-10-03): ladder 25662 'Climb-down' pairs with the basement's only ladder 25663 'Climb-up' at 1887,4269,0 (MapProbe locs - the jail with the knights' cells 25876 and Sir Lancelot/Bedivere/Lucan/Tristram/Palomedes locs; RS3 Wiki Keep Le Faye: 'There is a stairs and a small trap door to enter the Basement ... the family jail'). Landing 1888,4269,0 = the walkable tile east of 25663 (MapProbe reach 53). Keep Le Faye ground floor, south of Catherby.

teleports.name: keep_le_faye_copy_basement_down
teleports.source: King's Ransom keep basement (667 map, batch 10 2026-10-03): ladder 25662 'Climb-down' pairs with the basement's only ladder 25663 'Climb-up' at 1887,4269,0 (MapProbe locs - the jail with the knights' cells 25876 and Sir Lancelot/Bedivere/Lucan/Tristram/Palomedes locs; RS3 Wiki Keep Le Faye: 'There is a stairs and a small trap door to enter the Basement ... the family jail'). Landing 1888,4269,0 = the walkable tile east of 25663 (MapProbe reach 53). Second copy of the keep (region 6722, same locs as 2763-2780,3398-3407).

teleports.name: keep_le_faye_basement_up
teleports.source: King's Ransom keep basement (667 map, batch 10): the basement ladder 25663 (id pair of 25662) leads back up to the keep's own ladder 25662@2770,3407,0 (Keep Le Faye); landing 2771,3407,0 = walkable tile east of it (MapProbe reach 56). Without it the basement entered through 25662 would have no way out.

teleports.name: waterbirth_lighthouse_ladder
teleports.source: Waterbirth Island Dungeon sublevel ladder to the Lighthouse (RS3 Wiki Waterbirth Island Dungeon: 'At sublevel 2, there is a final ladder, which if used, will bring players to the Lighthouse dungeon'; OSRS Wiki: 'the ladder ... will send them into the Dagannoth under the Lighthouse', Horror from the Deep - completed here, QuestStatus). 667 map: the Dagannoth chamber (Void lighthouse.areas lighthouse_dungeon 2496-2559,9984-10047) has no counterpart ladder; landing = 2515,10008,0, the chamber tile Void lighthouse.teles.toml 4485 (2515,10006,1 delta z+3, level -1) lands on (MapProbe reach 45).

teleports.name: mobilising_armies_tower_basement_down
teleports.source: Mobilising Armies officer tower basement (667 map, batch 10): RS3 Wiki Mobilising Armies Command Centre: 'Junior Cadets could only enter the basement' of the officer tower (the lowest rank - open to everyone). The tower stairs 43885 'Climb-down' (2422,2833) pair with the basement room 2389-2397,9243-9250 and its only stairs 43897 'Climb-up' (2396,9246, 1x2) (placements_667.tsv + MapProbe). Landing 2395,9247,0 = walkable tile west of 43897 (MapProbe reach 48).

teleports.name: mobilising_armies_tower_basement_up
teleports.source: Mobilising Armies officer tower basement (667 map, batch 10): RS3 Wiki Mobilising Armies Command Centre: 'Junior Cadets could only enter the basement' of the officer tower (the lowest rank - open to everyone). The tower stairs 43885 'Climb-down' (2422,2833) pair with the basement room 2389-2397,9243-9250 and its only stairs 43897 'Climb-up' (2396,9246, 1x2) (placements_667.tsv + MapProbe). Back up: landing 2422,2834,0 = walkable tile north of 43885, reachable from the ring of duelling arrival 2412,2849 (MapProbe conn).

teleports.name: poison_waste_sewer_enter

Landing = the corridor tile east of the sewer exit (MapProbe reach 24).
